title: Isolated code execution, dependencies, network and resource controls
baseCommit: a347ec92 (KAN-133 BUILD-LAUNCH-02 head; composes the VMM-02 signing fabric)
whatBuilt: FILESYSTEM DENIAL: sandboxed code has NO filesystem access (contract: filesystemAccess: denied in every verdict)

EGRESS DENIAL: NO network access from sandboxed code (contract: networkEgress: denied); denied import patterns (os/sys/subprocess/socket/requests/urllib/eval/exec/open/__import__) refused BEFORE execution
RESOURCE LIMITS: CPU seconds, wall-clock timeout, memory MB, and output bytes all bounded; exceeding the output bound TERMINATES the execution (outcome: terminated)
SECRETS ISOLATION: no credentials, API keys, tokens or secrets visible to sandboxed code; undeclared env keys refused; secret-looking key names denied even if declared
DEPENDENCY ALLOWLIST: only allowlisted dependencies may be used; unlisted deps refused before execution
ARTIFACT RECEIPTS: signed verdicts capture stdout, artifacts (with SHA-256), exit code, and the policy digest; every verdict documents the deny paths
NO PERSISTENCE: nothing the sandbox writes survives the execution (persistedAfterExit: false)
